scene.testo: Lewis Hamilton posted a *message* on Instagram after the race in Mexico.
The Briton finished *second*, behind Max Verstappen.
First of all he congratulated Kimi Antonelli, the new *world champion*.
In Mexico the two Ferraris were ahead, with Hamilton ahead of *Leclerc*.
An incident at turn 4 changed the race and helped *Verstappen*.
Losing the *victory* hurts, writes Lewis, and internal fights must not damage the team.
He restated his *faith* in Ferrari: for him the best is yet to come.
